def test_01_verify_the_screen_when_user_clicks_on_the_create_your_own_shortcut_arrow_button_in_add_new_shortcuts_screen_C46(self):
        """
        Verify the screen.
        TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/46
        """
        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn()
        self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()

THEN: Follow naming convention: {action_verb}_{feature_context}_{element_descriptor}_{element_type}
IMPLEMENTATION: Examples: click_cancel_shortcut_go_back_btn(), verify_cancel_this_shortcut_title(), click_cancel_shortcut_yes_cancel_btn()

automation_scripts_rules.description: Test Case Purpose-Based Step Inclusion Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases verifying cancel/back button functionality
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing test cases that verify cancel or back button behavior
THEN: Must include implicit verification step to validate that cancel confirmation popup appears with correct messaging
IMPLEMENTATION: Add step 'Implicit - Verify that cancel confirmation popup is displayed with correct title' between back button click and confirmation button click

automation_scripts_rules.description: Framework vs Explicit Implementation Decision Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All test steps in automation implementation
rule_definition: WHEN: Determining whether to implement a step explicitly or delegate to framework
THEN: Setup/navigation steps (1-5) go to framework setup; user actions (6-7) are explicit; verifications can be explicit assertions or framework validation
IMPLEMENTATION: Preconditions and navigation → framework setup methods; User interactions → explicit page object calls; Final verifications → framework teardown or explicit assertions

automation_scripts_rules.description: Assertion Implementation Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All verification steps marked with 'assert' in script line
rule_definition: WHEN: A script line contains 'assert' keyword
THEN: Implement as explicit assertion statement that will fail the test if condition is not met
IMPLEMENTATION: Use assertion methods that return boolean and wrap in assert statement: 'assert self.page_object.verify_method()' with meaningful failure messages

automation_scripts_rules.description: Wait Strategy Implementation Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All intermediary steps involving element interaction
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing intermediary steps that involve element location or interaction
THEN: Include explicit wait conditions for element state (clickable, visible, present) before performing actions
IMPLEMENTATION: Use framework wait methods with appropriate timeouts: wait for clickable before clicks, wait for visible before verifications, wait for transitions after actions

automation_scripts_rules.description: Test Independence Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automated test implementations
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing automated tests
THEN: Each test must be independently executable with all required preconditions established in setup methods
IMPLEMENTATION: Steps 1-5 type preconditions must be in @BeforeTest/@BeforeMethod to ensure test can run independently without relying on other tests or execution order

automation_scripts_rules.description: Error Context Preservation Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All explicit automation script steps
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing explicit script actions (steps 6-7 in this case)
THEN: Include error handling that preserves context about which test step failed and what was being attempted
IMPLEMENTATION: Wrap page object method calls in try-catch blocks that log the test step context and capture screenshots on failure

automation_scripts_rules.description: Correlation Traceability Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation implementations
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing automation for manual test cases
THEN: Maintain clear traceability between manual test steps and automation implementation through correlation mapping
IMPLEMENTATION: Document mapping in correlation_steps_to_scripts format and ensure every manual step has corresponding automation implementation or explicit framework delegation

automation_scripts_rules.description: Reusable Component Extraction Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Common interaction patterns like popup handling
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing popup or modal interactions that may be reused across multiple test cases
THEN: Extract the interaction pattern into reusable page object methods that can be called from multiple tests
IMPLEMENTATION: Methods like click_cancel_shortcut_go_back_btn() and verify_cancel_this_shortcut_title() should be designed for reuse across any test needing cancel confirmation popup interaction

def test_06_verify_the_behavior_when_user_enables_the_print_destination_toggle_bar_in_add_shortcut_screen_C51(self):
        """
        Verify the behavior when user enables the print destination toggle bar.
        TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/51
        """
        self.fc.reset_app()
        self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn()
        self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress)
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_printer_device_card()
        self.hpx_printer_details.click_shortcuts_tile(raise_e=False)
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_shortcuts_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_add_new_shortcut_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_create_your_own_shortcut()
        self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_print_toggle_btn()
        assert self.hpx_shortcuts.is_continue_btn_enabled(), "Continue button should be enabled after toggling print option"

automation_scripts_rules.description: Application Launch Step Splitting Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Any test step involving application launch or initialization
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step contains 'Install and Launch' or similar application startup action
THEN: Split into two sub-steps - 1a for reset_app() and 1b for flow_load_home_screen()

IMPLEMENTATION: Execute self.fc.reset_app() followed by self.fc.flow_load_home_screen(skip_value_prop=False) with intermediary steps for cleanup, termination, data clearing, launch, value prop handling, and home screen loading

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Prerequisite Step Insertion Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test cases requiring printer connectivity without explicit device setup
rule_definition: WHEN: Test involves printer-specific actions but no explicit 'Add Device' step exists
THEN: Insert 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution: Add device and search printer' after app launch

IMPLEMENTATION: Execute self.hpx_printer_details.click_add_device_btn() → self.printers.search_printer_by_ip(self.p.ipAddress) with intermediary steps for button location, click action, search field interaction, IP entry, search initiation, result verification, and printer selection

automation_scripts_rules.description: Navigation Validation Step Insertion Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All navigation actions that transition between screens
rule_definition: WHEN: A click action navigates to a new screen (shortcuts_tile, add_new_shortcut_btn)
THEN: Insert 'Implicit Step – Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation' to verify screen title
IMPLEMENTATION: Use assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_[screen_name]_screen_title() with intermediary steps for element location, text retrieval, comparison, and assertion

automation_scripts_rules.description: Toggle Action and State Validation Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Steps involving UI toggles, switches, or state changes
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step involves enabling/disabling toggles (Print destination toggle)
THEN: Implement toggle action followed by state validation in subsequent step

IMPLEMENTATION: Execute self.hpx_shortcuts.click_edit_shortcut_print_toggle_btn() with intermediary steps for screen verification, toggle location, state checking, enabling action, and state verification

automation_scripts_rules.description: Final Verification Step Implementation Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps with generic verification requirements like 'Verify the screen'
rule_definition: WHEN: Test step contains generic verification language without specific elements
THEN: Implement specific validation based on test case purpose (continue button enabled for shortcut creation)
IMPLEMENTATION: Use assert self.hpx_shortcuts.is_continue_btn_enabled() with intermediary steps for button location, state checking, verification, and assertion

automation_scripts_rules.description: Method Chaining for Multi-Action Steps Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Test steps requiring multiple sequential script actions
rule_definition: WHEN: Single test step maps to multiple script methods that must execute in sequence
THEN: Use arrow notation (→) to chain methods in execution order
IMPLEMENTATION: Format as method1() → method2() ensuring each method completes before next executes, with separate intermediary steps for each chained method

automation_scripts_rules.description: Implicit Step Classification and Labeling Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All steps not explicitly stated in original test case
rule_definition: WHEN: Step is required for test execution but not in original test steps
THEN: Label as 'Implicit Step – Required for Test Execution' for prerequisites or 'Implicit Step – Supporting Step – Purpose of Test Case Validation' for validations
IMPLEMENTATION: Include clear purpose description and place at logical execution point with appropriate script mapping and intermediary steps

automation_scripts_rules.description: Parameter Usage in Script Methods Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: Script methods that accept parameters
rule_definition: WHEN: Script method supports parameters (raise_e, skip_value_prop)
THEN: Use parameters appropriately based on test context and error handling requirements
IMPLEMENTATION: Set raise_e=False for methods where error handling is managed at test level, skip_value_prop=False for first-time app launches

automation_scripts_rules.description: Object Hierarchy and Method Naming Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All automation script method calls
rule_definition: WHEN: Implementing any script action
THEN: Follow self.[page_object].[action_method]() pattern with descriptive naming
IMPLEMENTATION: Use page objects like hpx_printer_details, hpx_shortcuts with action methods like click_, verify_, is_ prefixes and clear element identification

automation_scripts_rules.description: Assertion Pattern for Validation Steps Rule
automation_scripts_rules.applies_to: All validation and verification steps
rule_definition: WHEN: Step requires validation or verification
THEN: Use Python assert statements with boolean-returning methods
IMPLEMENTATION: Format as assert self.[page_object].verify_[element]() or assert self.[page_object].is_[state]() with intermediary steps for element location, state checking, and assertion execution
